title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could cause…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the System Settings edit permission can cause the system to send stored root credentials for an external credential store to an attacker-controlled host. This occurs when the user changes the external credential store endpoint without providing replacement credentials, leading to credential exposure. The exposed credentials may include sensitive secrets such as access tokens, application secrets, account passwords, or client certificates.
